meta.note: Second BUBO-line node, for the outer part. Named by Nathan: KIDO.

kido.desc: Kido is the outer kernel-node, second in the BUBO line. BUBO (original C kernel) holds the inner system; Kido holds the outer (language ball).
kido.role: Compensates BUBO's flaws: BUBO is x86-bound C heritage (ARM needs ~80% rewrite); Kido is designed portable and adaptive from the start — the outer layer's kernel, built for where BUBO can't go.
kido.placement: The outer doll's kernel seat — counterpart to BUBO's seat in the inner system. Where BUBO is deep and fixed, Kido is outer and adaptive.
kido.relationship: Two kernels, one organism: BUBO (inner, C, stable core) + Kido (outer, adaptive, compensating). They divide the stack by doll layer, not by competition.
kido.honest_status: Architectural node in the system design today; a runnable Kido (like the BUBO ARM port) is a deep build, Phase 4 territory.
